text.p: Opta Food Ingredients Inc said Thursday the delays in the ramp-up of certain customers' products have impacted the company's revenue growth and this trend is expected to continue throughout the remainder of 1996.
It pointed out extended product testing, launch and ramp-up periods are common in the consumer food and food service industries.

The company reported revenue of $2.2 million for the third quarter, up from $2.0 million a year earlier. The net loss for the third quarter of 1996 was $1.2 million, or $0.11 per share, compared to a net loss of $1.1 million, or $.12 per share in the comparable 1995 quarter.

Per share figures reflect the increase in weighted average shares outstanding from 9.1 million in 1995 to 10.9 million in 1996, primarily due to the company's public stock offering in the third quarter of 1995, it said.
